messages:
sophie-sales: FYI incoming security questionnaire from Prospect OrionX. They sent a SIG+CAIQ and asked for completed answers + evidence by EOD Fri. Link: https://files.internal/orionx/sig-2026.zip :eyes:

raj-support: @sophie-sales thanks — do we have an internal owner yet? Also they mentioned POC access, might need temporary S3 creds for logs during testing.

maya-security: I can take the checklist / technical controls. Will need a week for full evidence collection if they push for screenshots + configs. Can we get the PO number so I can approve limited access?

sophie-sales: @maya-security thanks. PO pending — sales is trying to close this quarter, so timeline is tight. They also asked about SOC2 scope for the service — quick answer ok?

alex-legal: Quick: we cannot provide raw SOC artifacts externally. We can produce a SOC2 summary and redacted evidence as usual. I'll draft the standard redaction note.

samir-ops: On the S3 creds: we can create time-limited read-only role scoped to the POC bucket. Need an internal ticket for audit. If @raj-support opens it, we can turn it around in 24-48h.

raj-support: Opening ticket now. Intake-bot, please create a security-intake ticket and attach the form.

intake-bot: New ticket created: SI-10284. Assigned: maya-security (triage). Due date: 2026-05-15. Link: https://tickets.internal/SI-10284

maya-security: Got the ticket. Quick plan: 1) Map SIG sections to our controls, 2) Pull evidence artifacts (KMS policy, VPC flow logs, WAF rules), 3) Redact and upload to ticket. I'll post a checklist in the ticket by EOD today.

sophie-sales: Perfect. Heads up: the buyer's security lead asked specifically about key management and multi-region backups. @alex-legal and @samir-ops please prioritize those artifacts in the evidence pack.

alex-legal: Noted. I'll prepare the redaction template and a short cover letter explaining what we can share.

samir-ops: Will export KMS CMK policy + backup topology diagram. Will flag any customer-identifying info for redaction.

sophie-sales: Also — pricing ask: Prospect wants a POC discount tied to speed of delivery for evidence. Can sales offer a 30% POC discount if we deliver by Friday?

maya-security: Can't promise faster analysis, but I can prioritize the most requested artifacts first (KMS + backups + auth logs). Quality > speed for evidence.

raj-support: I'll add the POC discount request to the ticket notes for tracking. If legal needs to approve any commercial language, ping @alex-legal.

sophie-sales: Thanks all. Can we do a short sync tomorrow 10am to confirm who will upload which artifacts? If yes, I'll send invite and include the buyer.

maya-security: 10am works for me.

samir-ops: Works.

alex-legal: Can do.

raj-support: I'll field the invite and add the SR link.

intake-bot: Reminder scheduled: SI-10284 status check in 48 hours.
